universal_lens: Low-to-high feature fusion architecture integrates multi-resolution visual representations via skip connections and channel concatenation. gse_mapping: Situational reasoning engine tracks dynamic swimmer states through temporal heatmap transitions and resolves kinematic ambiguities via feature fusion.
